messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Business Services and Partnerships" as it appears in the following examples.
['I will be grateful to have you as my foreign partner to enable us carry out a deal of Eight million two hundred thousand Great Britain Pounds(£8,200,000.00).', 'I am using his correspondence to urgently seek and request your assistance in an sensitive but highly beneficial financial arrangement.', 'Dearest one, permit me to inform you of my desire of going into business relationship with you.', 'We agree that 40 % of this money will be for you as foreign partner, in respect to the provision of foreign account, 10 % will be set aside for expenses incurred during the business and 50 % would be for mean my colleague.', 'You will assist to purchase this product, 10%of our total purchase will be paid to you as your commission for the assistance rendered.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
